violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Chlorine solution in bucket holding wiping cloth was found at 50ppm. Chlorine solutions for holding wiping cloths should be 100ppm.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Hot water was not available at hand washing sink in the kitchen. Hand washing sink should be supplied with hot water.
